info.name: Slickdeals - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description: A dark cybersecurity-inspired theme for Slickdeals.net, combining luminous green terminal accents, smoky black backgrounds, and translucent glass-like deal cards and menus. A custom black-and-neon-green circuit wallpaper is compressed and embedded directly inside the stylesheet, so the theme does not rely on an external image host.
